# Keep the documented template ID equal to the actual lookup ID

The row’s header comment says Template ID #calendarDialogRow, while the constructor lookup and template both use calendarDialogRowTemplate. Proposed local documentation correction: use the exact actual ID so a reader can find the template. This is a verified comment-to-code mismatch; it is not evidence that template lookup fails or that reviewers requested the correction. This is static source and test-code inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending; source landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.

Scope: calendar template documentation.
